tools.name: exchange_rates
tools.description: Get Frankfurter exchange rates for a base currency. Give base and quote to get the rate for one currency pair. Otherwise returns rates from base to the currencies in quotes (comma-separated). Add date for a historical rate, or from and to for a time series, with group to downsample it by week or month. providers restricts rates to a provider or dataset key. expand=providers adds per-provider rates to each row. Use provider_rates to get rates from one specific provider.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency code, e.g. EUR. Give with quote for a single pair, or alone or with quotes for rates from this base.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Quote currency code for a single pair, e.g. USD. Only used together with base.

parameters.name: quotes
parameters.description: Comma-separated target currency codes, e.g. USD,GBP.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date of a historical rate, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-01-15.

parameters.name: from_
parameters.description: Start date of a time series, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date of a time series, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Downsample a time series: week or month.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Restrict rates to a provider or dataset key, e.g. ecb.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Set to providers to add per-provider rates to each row.

tools.name: provider_rates
tools.description: Get exchange rates directly from one provider, chosen with provider (e.g. ecb). Give base and quote to get that provider's rate for one currency pair. Otherwise returns that provider's rates from base to the currencies in quotes. Add date for one day, or from and to for a time series, with group week or month to downsample it. Use exchange_rates for rates across providers.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider key, e.g. ecb. See the providers tool to list keys.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency code, e.g. EUR. Give with quote for a single pair.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Quote currency code for a single pair, e.g. USD. Only used together with base.

parameters.name: quotes
parameters.description: Comma-separated target currency codes, e.g. USD,GBP.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date of the rate, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-01-15.

parameters.name: from_
parameters.description: Start date of a time series, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date of a time series, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Downsample a time series: week or month.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Restrict rates to a provider or dataset key, e.g. ecb.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Set to providers to add per-provider rates to each row.

tools.name: currencies
tools.description: List available currencies with provider coverage, or get details and provider coverage for one currency. Give currency (e.g. EUR) for one currency. Otherwise lists currencies; set scope to all to include legacy currencies.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code, e.g. EUR. Leave out to list currencies.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Set to all to include legacy currencies. Only used when listing.

tools.name: providers
tools.description: List the providers behind the API, or get details for one provider including its datasets. Give provider (e.g. ecb) for one provider; otherwise lists all providers.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider key, e.g. ecb. Leave out to list all providers.

excluded.reason: Returns CSV text rather than JSON; exchange_rates returns the same rates as JSON.
